text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.biomeCh: Share of 72x72-chunk areas on the outer islands that hold one patch, 28-44 chunks across, spanning several islands (0 to 1). Default: 0.4.
Lets the two biomes (foggy core and fringe) replace large patches of the outer End islands in new chunks.
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.budsGro: Buds grow into trees on their own in light level 9 or more; bone meal always works.
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.enableS: Turns the bundled sub-mod Simple End Dragon Fight on or off (only while Simple End itself is on).
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.enabled: Turns Simple End on or off. Off keeps all blocks and items, but buds stop growing and the biomes stop spreading into new chunks.
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.forestF: Client: how far the fog is pulled toward the forest core fog (0 to 1). Default: 0.85.
Client: seen from outside (also from above), the Ash Valley and Dawnlands forests rise as a wall of fog. Default: off (plain Vanilla fog).
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.longerD: Dropped End-wood items stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
text.autoconfig.simpleend.option.voidSaf: Dropped End-wood items float back up when they fall below the world.
jei.simpleend.info.nibblemite_drops: When a Nibblemite dies it may drop a Chorus Fruit (more with Looting).

simpleend.guide.page.1.title: Simple End
simpleend.guide.page.1: Ashwood and Duskwood, buds that grow End trees or stick scrub, End grass and the Ash Valley and Dawnlands biomes on the outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.2.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.2: Two End woods with the full Vanilla wood set:
simpleend.guide.page.3.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.3: log, wood, stripped log and wood, planks, stairs, slab, fence, fence gate, door, trapdoor, button, pressure plate, sign, hanging sign, shelf, leaves, boat and boat with chest.
simpleend.guide.page.4.title: Buds, gigantic End trees and stick trees
simpleend.guide.page.4: Ash Bud and Dusk Bud grow on End stone or dirt. Outside the End, in light 9 or more, a bud becomes a gigantic wood tree; in the dark bone meal turns it into stick scrub.
simpleend.guide.page.5.title: Buds, gigantic End trees and stick trees
simpleend.guide.page.5: In the End every bud grows a stick tree - wood comes only from buds planted outside the End.
simpleend.guide.page.6.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.6: End leaves are no full block: see-through tendril fronds around a small crystal, tinted by the biome. Each leaf counts its neighbors that are not air (any block):
simpleend.guide.page.7.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.7: 0-3 make it loose and airy, 4-5 medium, all 6 dense and dark - it changes as blocks next to it are placed or removed.
simpleend.guide.page.8.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.8: Only the few leaves a tree marked drop its bud or fruit (always);
simpleend.guide.page.9.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.9: all drop sticks now and then. Drift Fruit ripens only in the End - elsewhere the fruit is Spoiled Drift Fruit. Both End leaves act like a cobweb.
simpleend.guide.page.10.title: Void-safe wood
simpleend.guide.page.10: Dropped End-wood items (logs, planks, everything of the sets, buds, End grass, Drift Fruit) are not lost in the void:
simpleend.guide.page.11.title: Void-safe wood
simpleend.guide.page.11: below the world they float back up and hover just above the bottom. They also stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
simpleend.guide.page.12.title: End grass and End bushes
simpleend.guide.page.12: Wiry End grass and twiggy End bushes, like Vanilla dry grass and dead bushes, standing on End stone and wherever those stand (sand, terracotta, dirt, grass, moss, mud, farmland).
simpleend.guide.page.13.title: End grass and End bushes
simpleend.guide.page.13: They grow in Ash Valley and Dawnlands and sparsely on all outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.14.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.14: Two large End biomes on the outer islands (never on the dragon island):
simpleend.guide.page.15.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.15: rare patches 28-44 chunks (450-700 blocks) across with a wavy rim, spanning several islands, replace the End highlands/midlands/barrens.
simpleend.guide.page.16.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.16: Each has a foggy core (Ash Valley, Dawnlands) inside a fringe (Ash Valley Fringe, Dawnlands Fringe).
simpleend.guide.page.17.title: Nibblemite
simpleend.guide.page.17: A small, passive Endermite kin that lives in Ash Valley and Dawnlands in groups of 3-5, colored after its biome (pale gray with lavender, taupe with rose). It nibbles End stone like sheep graze:
simpleend.guide.page.18.title: Nibblemite
simpleend.guide.page.18: the block under it becomes Burrowed End Stone, which turns back into End stone after a few minutes.
simpleend.guide.page.19.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.19: SimpleBuilding bundles Simple End ("Enable Simple End"); Simple End bundles Simple End Dragon Fight ("Enable Simple End Dragon Fight" in config/simpleend.json). Each level has its own switch;
simpleend.guide.page.20.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.20: Dragon Fight runs only while Simple End is on. Simple End also plays alone.
simpleend.guide.page.21.title: Commands
simpleend.guide.page.21: /simpleend config shows and changes every option of config/simpleend.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once.
